HUNTER.sv.label: Planner BIS · weave build
HUNTER.sv.note: Our own sim run: the planner's suggested gear on the default weave build, full raid buffs, a 180 s raid boss. Ranged weapon DPS stands in for all weapon DPS.

HUNTER.sv.label: Community PvP · 20 s burst
HUNTER.sv.note: Our own sim run: the community Survival PvP build (WoW Forever Builds, MIT) on a 20-second burst against a level-60 player-like target with 3,100 armor. Burst weights for PvP gearing; it does not model a real opponent.

WARRIOR.arms.label: Planner BIS · Arms
WARRIOR.arms.note: Our own sim run: the planner's suggested gear (a two-hander, so the Arms build) with full raid buffs on a 180 s raid boss.

WARRIOR.arms.label: Community PvP · 20 s burst
WARRIOR.arms.note: Our own sim run: the community Arms PvP build (WoW Forever Builds, MIT) on a 20-second burst against a level-60 player-like target with 3,100 armor. Burst weights for PvP gearing; it does not model a real opponent.
